mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO content_actions (id, user_id, entity_type, entity_id, action_type, action_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{actionType}, 1, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE content_actions SET action_status=0, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND entity_type=#{entityType} AND entity_id=#{entityId} AND action_type=#{actionType} AND action_status=1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM content_actions WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND action_type=#{actionType} AND action_status=1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
